findings.description: Maria Vázsan was the wife of János Czibula; the couple's daughter Maria Czibula was baptised at Bojnice on 9 June 1900.
supporting_sources: Slovakia, Church and Synagogue Books, 1592-1935 — baptism of Maria Czibula, Bojnice, 9 Jun 1900, daughter of János Czibula and Maria Vázsan
